definitions.definition: P1 input faults precede P2 regressions; only the otherwise-green P3 outcome exits zero.
The quality predicate combines exact recall, concept recall, and real-query file-rank families.
The real-query manifest binds reproducible identity, source, replay, bundle, vector, and label provenance.
Shared floors protect exact and concept metrics, aggregate real-query MRR, per-shape MRR tolerance, and per-shape hit@5.
Every production ruling token resolves to exactly one pinned class before scoring.
Retrieval profiles derive offset capability from the published schema and probe declared offset behavior.
Sampling totality records empty and under-populated strata without undefined arithmetic.
B1 slice fences are pairwise disjoint and their union equals the exhaustive B1 fence.
Quality modes are evaluate, verify, and record-reference; vector recording is separate authoring.
Post-release estimation is five-stratum conditional weighting with explicit interval arithmetic.
Rubric and estimator metadata never enter real-query-postA.json or a quality reference.
B1 owns benchmark infrastructure and no campaign A or B2 product path.
Canonical episode identities and scored populations are defended by exact set equality.
An empty post-release estimator has exactly labelled_total, population, and estimator fields.
Replay forwards each recorded includeTests boolean and its recorded or default source.
Earlier fold closure is superseded by later normative ledger rulings.
CI evaluates the committed reference except for the narrow full manifest-and-bundle-only verify diff.
Reports compare conditional 3996/6469 and projected 3996/20183 estimates with denominators.
Sampling traverses five fixed strata and selects 60 each using BLAKE3-seeded ChaCha8 without redistribution.
Every quality mode rejects zero included benchmark identities as empty_population without reference writes.
Mechanism projections are independently rounded estimates totaling 6470, not a 6469-identity partition.
All evidence and load-bearing citations are pinned to 30d4a64f99b3b15fd88be6cf962fff4b3fe5ea17.
Concept vectors use pinned tree, content or query hash, and template keys; misses are faults.
Valid stop tokens are ten_files, exhausted, and page_cap, with page_cap highest precedence; depth_cap is reserved.
